claim_boundary: The predicted 0.17 mas scale is compared only with public model position dispersion and detector pixel scales. Subpixel centroiding can outperform a pixel, so this is not an impossibility theorem. However, the public image positions are fit inputs/outputs and no independent sub-mas covariance is materialized; direct scoring would be circular. No Tau or time inference is authorized.
